segments.text: Hello friends, welcome to your channel HSC StudyGuide

segments.text: Today we are going to talk about RCCB

segments.text: i.e. Recidual Current Circuit Breaker

segments.text: and in this we are going to talk about RCCB's Ratings

segments.text: i.e. about its Recidual Current Sensitivity

segments.text: So first of all we know about RCCB
segments.zh: 首先我们来了解 RCCB，

segments.text: i.e. what is RCCB about it
segments.zh: 也就是 RCCB 是什么。

segments.text: So RCCB means Recidual Current Circuit Breaker
segments.zh: RCCB 就是剩余电流动作断路器，

segments.text: This is also called RCCB
segments.zh: 它也被称为 RCD，

segments.text: i.e. Recidual Current Device
segments.zh: 也就是剩余电流保护装置。

segments.text: This is an electrical wiring device
segments.zh: 这是一种电气布线装置，

segments.text: Its function is that it disconnects the current
segments.zh: 它的作用是切断电流，

segments.text: Whenever it detects that the current is leaking
segments.zh: 每当它检测到电流发生泄漏，

segments.text: That is also in the earth wire
segments.zh: 而且是泄漏到地线里时。

segments.text: It also protects you
segments.zh: 它还能保护你，

segments.text: Whenever your direct contact happens with it
segments.zh: 每当你直接接触到它时。

segments.text: So if you do not like the electric shock
segments.zh: 所以如果你不想受到电击，

segments.text: Or if you do not like the electric shock
segments.zh: 或者如果你不想受到电击，

segments.text: It protects you against it
segments.zh: 它都能保护你免受电击。

segments.text: Now let's know about RCCB's Ratings
segments.zh: 现在我们来了解 RCCB 的额定值。

segments.text: So it has Recidual Current Sensitivity
segments.zh: 它有剩余电流灵敏度，

segments.text: Like 10mA, 30mA, 100mA, 300mA, 500mA, or 1000mA
segments.zh: 比如 10mA、30mA、100mA、300mA、500mA 或 1000mA。

segments.text: Now you have to understand
segments.zh: 现在你要明白，

segments.text: That the different Recidual Current Sensitivity
segments.zh: 不同的剩余电流灵敏度

segments.text: Is according to the purpose of its tripping level
segments.zh: 是根据其脱扣级别的用途来定的。

segments.text: So the recommended tripping level
segments.zh: 所以推荐的脱扣级别，

segments.text: For its maximum shock protections
segments.zh: 为了获得最大的电击防护，

segments.text: We use 30mA
segments.zh: 我们使用 30mA。

segments.text: Then after that
segments.zh: 然后在那之后，

segments.text: If we apply the tripping level of 100mA
segments.zh: 如果我们采用 100mA 的脱扣级别，

segments.text: So it also gives you shock protection
segments.zh: 它也能为你提供电击防护，

segments.text: But it gives less than 30mA
segments.zh: 但提供的防护比 30mA 的要少，

segments.text: And we have to use it only when
segments.zh: 而且只有在

segments.text: If we cannot use the device of 30mA
segments.zh: 无法使用 30mA 的装置时才使用它。

segments.text: At that time
segments.zh: 在那时，

segments.text: When the tripping level of 300mA
segments.zh: 当脱扣级别是 300mA 时，

segments.text: We never have to use it for shock protection
segments.zh: 我们绝不能把它用于电击防护，

segments.text: Because its purpose is
segments.zh: 因为它的用途是

segments.text: To protect the fire and equipment
segments.zh: 防火和保护设备。
